name: handoff_consistency
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
ids=json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text())['ids'];r=json.loads(Path('results.json').read_text());p=json.loads(Path('literal-provenance.json').read_text());assert set(r)==set(map(str,ids)) and len(p)==20
for x in p:
 raw=Path('literals/'+str(x['id'])+'.jsonl').read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==x['raw_line_sha256'];assert json.loads(raw)['statement']==x['statement'];assert hashlib.sha256(x['statement'].encode()).hexdigest()==x['statement_utf8_sha256'];assert hashlib.sha256(x['statement_token'].encode()).hexdigest()==x['statement_token_sha256'];assert raw.endswith(b'\n')
for n in [1,2,3]:
 d=json.loads(Path('search'+str(n)+'-response.json').read_text());print('search_response',n,'type',type(d).__name__,'size',Path('search'+str(n)+'-response.json').stat().st_size)
assert all(x['credit']==0 and not x['qualified_survivor'] for x in r.values())
last='0'*64;records=[]
for raw in Path('guard-ledger.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True):
 d=json.loads(raw);assert d['previous']==last and d['seq']==len(records);last=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest();records.append(d)
print('PASS exact20 provenance gates zero credit; ledger',len(records),'events',last)
print('history hash mismatches',json.loads(Path('history-summary.json').read_text())['hash_mismatches'])
